column5: Look: clean and minimal. Pale flat panels; shootable surfaces clearly darker; cyan gun light and ground marker; orange cube; green glowing exit door and pressure plate. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
References: Portal (the theme only: a sterile test facility, one room one idea). The gravity gun spike, prototypes/gravity-gun-spike-2026-11-15/ (the look and the feel as played).
View: 3D · Camera: first-person.
Gravity gun that grabs only dark panels
Room 1: flip to cross a wall (safe)
Room 2: a deadly long fall broken into two safe ones
Room 3: move the cube onto the pressure plate by gravity; the plate opens the exit door
Checkpoint at each room's start; R restarts the room
Crosshair shows whether a surface can be shot and whether the fall is deadly
Results screen at the exit: time and deaths *(guessed)*
Each switch and its door share a colour *(guessed)*
gravity gun · in the slice
physics objects fall to the ground plane · in the slice
pressure plate opens the door · in the slice
You start in a small pale room facing a wall too high to climb.
One dark panel sits on the ceiling.
You shoot it, fall up, walk across the ceiling past the wall, and shoot a dark floor panel to come back down.
The door to room two is open ahead.
*(guessed)*
The first real think is room two, about a minute in: the next dark panel is far away and the crosshair warns the fall is deadly, so you must break it into two shorter falls.
A death puts you back at the room's start.
Room three adds the cube: only gravity can move it onto the plate.
*(room contents guessed)*
